probe: M021 T002 companion facade: the development build of the counter fixture, and the served page

build.sampleNote: sample is an observation, not an assertion.

peerResolution.chosenMechanism: preserveSymlinks: true in the fixture's development configuration
peerResolution.why: npm installs a directory file: specifier as a symlink (the fixture's lock records "link": true), so the builder's default realpath resolution anchors the package's @angular/* imports at the package root and pulls the root checkout's 22.1.8 into the same bundle as the fixture's 22.2.2. preserveSymlinks keeps the fixture's node_modules as the anchor, so the package resolves the fixture's own files and the entry's Router is the app's class.

counterExample.mechanism: the same file: dependency with preserveSymlinks unset
counterExample.meaning: the entry's Router was the root checkout's class, so the identity comparison could not hold: declared, no resolved

served.how: a static server over the emitted development output; read in the page's main world through control-angular-dev-app's playwright-cli session control-ngdev-url-4455
served.extensionNote: the extension's panel is an optimized build and building it is outside this task (N5); none of the four fields below is written by the extension, and the entry-scoped key difference excludes the page's own bootstrap keys
served.isDevModeEvidence: globalThis.ng is published only when ngDevMode is true, and the entry exists at all only because provideAiDevTools() writes it inside if (isDevMode())
served.identityWithoutInjectorArgument: throws: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'get'); Angular's ɵgetRouterInstance takes the injector, which the niladic form omits

reconciliation.note: A clean build (output directory deleted first) emits three development bundles, matching m022-ng-context; the earlier single-bundle recording was stale. T004's three bundles are genuine, not leftovers from a reused output directory.

verdict: works: the one entry survives the development build, and its Router is the app's own class
